import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# Connect to the database
conn = sqlite3.connect('./dacomp-044.sqlite')

# Read the CSV file again
csv_path = 'complication_management_supplementary_batch.csv'
supplementary_data = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

# Create a mapping between CSV columns and target table columns
column_mapping = {
    'Complication ID': 'Complication ID',
    'Case ID': 'Case ID',
    'Complication Type (Pneumonia/Encephalitis/Hepatitis)': 'Complication Type (Pneumonia/Encephalitis/Hepatitis)',
    'Date of Onset': 'Date of Onset',
    'Severity Grade (Mild/Moderate/Severe)': 'Severity Grade (Mild/Moderate/Severe)',
    'Complication Treatment Cost': 'Complication Treatment Cost'
}

# Initialize missing columns with default values
missing_columns = [
    'Complication Outcome (Recovery/Sequelae)',
    'Sequelae Type (Scar/Neurological Damage)',
    'Insurance Reimbursement Rate',
    'Complication Reporting Timeliness',
    'Complication Alert Indicator (e.g., CRP > 50)',
    'Complication Training Record ID',
    'Complication-Related Research ID',
    'Complication Management Timeliness',
    'Complication Multidisciplinary Consultation ID',
    'Complication Data Anonymization Status',
    'Complication Statistical Flag'
]

# Create a new DataFrame with all target columns
transformed_data = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
    'Complication ID', 'Case ID', 'Complication Type (Pneumonia/Encephalitis/Hepatitis)',
    'Date of Onset', 'Severity Grade (Mild/Moderate/Severe)', 'Complication Treatment Cost',
    'Complication Outcome (Recovery/Sequelae)', 'Sequelae Type (Scar/Neurological Damage)',
    'Insurance Reimbursement Rate', 'Complication Reporting Timeliness',
    'Complication Alert Indicator (e.g., CRP > 50)', 'Complication Training Record ID',
    'Complication-Related Research ID', 'Complication Management Timeliness',
    'Complication Multidisciplinary Consultation ID', 'Complication Data Anonymization Status',
    'Complication Statistical Flag'
])

# Populate the transformed data
for _, row in supplementary_data.iterrows():
    new_row = {}
    for csv_col, target_col in column_mapping.items():
        new_row[target_col] = row[csv_col]
    
    for col in missing_columns:
        new_row[col] = None  # Set missing columns to NULL
    
    transformed_data = pd.concat([transformed_data, pd.DataFrame([new_row])], ignore_index=True)

# Insert the transformed data into the database
transformed_data.to_sql(
    name='complication_management',
    con=conn,
    if_exists='append',
    index=False
)

# Record the ingestion in the log table
batch_id = 'BATCH20230101001'
source_file = 'complication_management_supplementary_batch.csv'
loaded_at = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
row_count = len(supplementary_data)

conn.execute('''
    INSERT INTO data_ingestion_log (batch_id, source_file, loaded_at, row_count)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
''', (batch_id, source_file, loaded_at, row_count))

# Commit and close the connection
conn.commit()
conn.close()

print(f"Successfully inserted {row_count} rows into the database.")
print(f"Batch ID: {batch_id}")
print(f"Source file: {source_file}")
print(f"Loaded at: {loaded_at}")
